headline.lead: Trial balance for “BRIDGE INTEGRATED CTRL LAB”, 1 Apr 2025 to 31 Mar 2026: read for every ledger. 1 ledger does not add up: the closing is not the opening plus the debit and credit totals (see movements_differ_by); each is shown as Tally sent it.

limitations: 1 ledger(s) carry movements_differ_by: their closing is not their opening plus their debit and credit totals, counting an empty amount as zero. Each is returned as Tally sent it and nothing is corrected. On the books measured this was a Closing Stock ledger whose closing balance was keyed on Tally's screen: Tally kept the opening as the closing and showed the change only in the debit total. The closing of such a ledger is not necessarily the figure Tally's statements use: on the book not integrated with inventory they used the keyed figure, and on the integrated one they valued the stock from the stock item. The column totals include the closing as sent.
Not voucher-level reconciliation or an atomic snapshot
Native empty amounts are not numeric zero
Includes ledger masters Tally may hide in its screen
